notes.text: This sheet has no visible authorial page number. Pale foliation 67 at the lower left belongs to another unnamed hand. The main writing includes an opening relation paragraph, a passage headed Lemme with a four-object square, a topological-category paragraph, a functor display, two application rows, two lower coproduct displays, a slanted NB and a continuation at the bottom.

The manuscript cancels Cela posé and later symétrique at the top, adding réflexive above the latter. It then writes a transitivity assertion and an opening pi-zero expression. The small parenthesized Sigma arguments are physically lowered at every inspected occurrence on this sheet. Those placements and the underlined b/s labels are retained from the ink.

The passage headed Lemme contains the square X, X-prime, Y, Y-prime with labels f, f-prime, g, g-prime, followed by a pi-zero expression and the word surjectif. The manuscript calls the square cartésien and uses fibrant in the adjoining prose. These are descriptions of what the manuscript writes; no proof check is claimed. The two vertical terminal shapes are represented directly as filled ink, rounded on the left and more pointed on the right.

The category paragraph has a written interlinear pré, an added equality =pi_0(Sigma_0), a bracketed word strongly favouring anglicisme and a relocated canonique. The small glyph beside I is comma-like, but I-zero is retained as a local alternative. Each branch of the marked I expression repeats the same one physical equality insertion so that its attachment and punctuation remain explicit.

The manuscript writes an underlined-Sigma to I functor with an underlined varphi label, followed by phi-zero and phi-one application rows. The explanation of I-one is appended at the far right and contains a cancelled intermediate ending. Its live last line visibly stops at =I against the paper edge. No continuation beyond the edge is supplied. The cancellation's index and final factor remain unresolved.

The lower displays contain two separate coproduct equalities; the second overwrites a former sign tentatively read as Sigma, whose contour remains partly concealed. In the slanted NB the author writes that the comp. connexes of Sigma_0 and Sigma_1 are ouvertes. The abbreviation and the underlines of NB and les are retained. This reports the author's marginal assumption without checking it.

The right-hand explanatory block has two separately underlined labels and two short unheaded connectors. The following delta expression contains a densely cancelled mathematical predecessor, tentatively read as an identity-shaped expression with raised Sigma and lower x. Its structure remains marked as doubtful, while the rewritten identity expression to its right is readable.

The bottom prose has a live opening parenthesis after cancelled et ainsi, the word implique, an underlined varphi in the compatibility expression and another underlined varphi after De plus. The last words on this sheet read est un. The transcription was made only from this assigned leaf and its two drafts; no following leaf was consulted to complete the phrase.

Comparison-count review: the visible raised pré and its insertion leader remain recorded in the transcription, inventory and audit box. C and H both give the same prefix; their inserted/supplied wrapper difference alone supplies no substantive reading difference. Former row 068-11 is excluded from the changes table and collation for that reason. No manuscript reading changed.
